abstract: Peptide variations in the alpha-subunit (molecules starting at alpha 3 and alpha 4) and beta-subunit (missing linkages at beta 44-45 and beta 47-48) of hCG have been reported by several investigators. Studies, however, have been limited to standard hCG preparations (purified from large pools of urine) and other hCG samples from mixed urines. In this study we used chromatographic procedures to purify the total hCG content of 13 individual urines, 6 from patients with pregnancy and 7 from those with trophoblast disease (no hCG-containing fractions were excluded). Then, we examined for the first time the peptide variability among individual samples of hCG. We report 1) that individual hCG preparations have nicks (missing linkages) in the beta-subunit, primarily between residue 47-48 (11 of 13 samples) and, less commonly, at the linkage 44-45 or 46-47 (3 of 13 samples); 2) the extent of nicking varies greatly between individual preparations (range, 0-100% of molecules); 3) varying alpha-subunit N-terminal heterogeneity (N-terminus starting at alpha 3 or alpha 4) was also present (range, 0-28% of molecules), but was confined to preparations from individuals with trophoblast disease (6 of 7 samples from trophoblast disease urine, 0 of 6 from pregnancy urine); 4) hCG missing the beta-subunit C-terminal region was also detected (2 of 13 hCG preparations); and 5) 1 of 13 preparations was nicked on the hCG alpha-subunit, between residues 70 and 71. Thus, 12 of 13 individual hCG samples demonstrated at least 1 of 4 different forms of peptide heterogeneity. We conclude that individual hCG samples vary widely in the type and extent of peptide heterogeneity, an observation that is not appreciated when pools of hCG are studied.
abstract_ja: 妊娠（6検体）およびトロホブラスト病（7検体）の尿から、個別にhCGを精製し、ペプチドの異種性を検討した。β鎖では13検体中11検体で47〜48位の間、3検体で44〜45位または46〜47位での切断が認められ、切断の程度は0〜100%と個体間で大きく異なった。α鎖N末端の異種性（3位または4位から始まるもの）は、トロホブラスト病の7検体中6検体にのみ認められ、妊娠の6検体では認められなかった。β鎖C末端領域を欠くhCGも2検体で検出された。α鎖の70位と71位の間の切断は1検体で認められた。以上より、13検体中12検体が4種類の異種性のうち少なくとも1つを示した。個別hCG検体はペプチド異種性の種類と程度が大きく異なり、これはhCGをプールして検討した場合には認識されない所見である。
